name: Exp_LeManTrendHist
summary: This EA trades based on the LeManTrendHist custom indicator, which is a trend-following histogram that compares three smoothed moving average periods (13, 21, 34) to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the histogram values rise (Value[0] > Value[1]) and sell positions when they fall (Value[0] < Value[1]), with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA includes independent toggles for opening and closing positions on both the buy and sell sides.
summary_zh: 该EA基于LeManTrendHist自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一个趋势跟踪直方图，通过比较三个平滑均线周期（13、21、34）来判断趋势方向。当直方图值上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。EA对多空方向的开仓和平仓分别提供独立开关控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于LeManTrendHist直方图指标，该指标融合了三个不同周期（13、21、34）的平滑移动平均值，并通过额外的EMA平滑和用户可选的平滑算法（如JJMA、JurX、ParMA等）来生成趋势信号。入场条件为：当直方图前一值小于再前一值（Value[1]<Value[2]）且当前值大于前一值（Value[0]>Value[1]）时开多仓；当直方图前一值大于再前一值且当前值小于前一值时开空仓。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈设置，以及反向信号触发平仓（如多头信号出现时平空仓，空头信号出现时平多仓）。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损保证金、亏损余额的比例计算，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1，结合止损1000点和止盈2000点来控制单笔风险。策略使用SignalBar参数决定信号判断的K线位置，默认为1即前一根已闭合K线，避免了未闭合K线的信号漂移问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the LeManTrendHist histogram indicator, which integrates three smoothed moving averages of different periods (13, 21, 34) and applies additional EMA smoothing with a user-selectable smoothing algorithm (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.) to generate trend signals. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the histogram's previous value is less than the one before that (Value[1]<Value[2]) and the current value exceeds the previous value (Value[0]>Value[1]), indicating an upward trend shift; a sell position opens under the opposite conditions. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) settings, plus reverse signal closures where a buy signal closes sell positions and vice versa. Position sizing supports multiple modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-free-margin-based, loss-balance-based proportional calculations, and a fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1), which combined with the 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit constrains per-trade risk. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter (default 1) to determine which bar to evaluate signals on, avoiding signal repainting from unclosed bars.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损保证金/亏损余额/固定手数）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号判断使用的K线索引

pros: 使用多周期均线（13/21/34，斐波那契数列）构建趋势判断，逻辑合理
提供多种平滑算法选择（JJMA、JurX、ParMA等），适应不同市场环境
多空开仓和平仓独立控制，灵活性高，便于只交易单方向
默认SignalBar=1使用已闭合K线判断信号，避免重绘问题
止损止盈配置完善，且有滑点控制参数
pros_en: Uses Fibonacci-based moving average periods (13/21/34) for trend detection, providing logical trend-following structure
Offers multiple smoothing algorithm options (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) for adaptability to different market conditions
Independent toggles for buy/sell opening and closing provide high flexibility for directional bias trading
Default SignalBar=1 uses closed bars for signal evaluation, avoiding repainting issues
Complete stop-loss and take-profit configuration with slippage control parameter
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点在H4周期上跨度极大，可能导致较大单笔亏损
缺少追踪止损功能，盈利头寸可能在回撤中损失大部分利润
未检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
依赖外部自定义指标LeManTrendHist，增加了部署复杂性和依赖风险
没有交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
cons_en: The 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit are extremely wide on H4 timeframe, potentially leading to large per-trade losses
No trailing stop functionality means profitable positions may give back significant gains during reversals
No check for existing same-direction positions, which could lead to duplicate position opening
Depends on an external custom indicator LeManTrendHist, increasing deployment complexity and dependency risk
No trading session/time filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
improvements: 添加同方向持仓检查逻辑，避免重复开仓导致过度杠杆
增加追踪止损功能和交易时间过滤，提升盈利保护和成交质量
improvements_en: Add same-direction position checking logic to prevent duplicate entries and overleveraging
Add trailing stop functionality and trading session filters to improve profit protection and execution quality

risk_points: 1000点止损在H4周期下单笔风险较大，若仓位管理不当可能造成显著亏损
未检查现有持仓状态，存在重复开仓风险
依赖外部指标文件，若缺失则EA初始化失败但不会造成资金损失
risk_points_en: The 1000-point stop-loss on H4 carries significant per-trade risk if position sizing is not carefully managed
No existing position check creates risk of duplicate entries and excessive leverage
Dependency on external indicator file causes initialization failure but not financial loss
